title: Defenseply Expands KINFRA Industrial Facility Footprint with Advanced Extrusion Capacity
excerpt: Representing a strategic expansion into automated composite engineering, our expanded footprint at KINFRA Industrial Park increases production to over 110,000 calibrated boards annually.
content:
DEFENSEPLY INTERNATIONAL LLP has announced a significant expansion of its advanced manufacturing plant situated within the government-supported KINFRA Industrial Park in Kuttippuram, Kerala.

Backed by the AP Group and NGH Group, the facility expansion integrates multi-line automated polymer extrusion lines, dedicated high-tension industrial power, and precision laser calibration systems. The new installed capacity elevates our annual production volume to over 110,400 calibrated structural boards and over 200,000 meters of precision-moulded composite profiles.

This strategic capital commitment positions Defenseply to meet surging institutional demand across coastal commercial infrastructure, high-rise residential towers, and international containerized export channels.

title: Breakthrough in Calcium-Zinc Polymer Compounding Aligns with Global Green Standards
excerpt: Our Center of Excellence laboratory announces an advanced zero-lead composite formulation, delivering extreme flexural modulus while achieving strict ISO 14001 environmental compliance.
content:
The Defenseply in-house polymer research laboratory has achieved a major technological milestone with the formal deployment of its next-generation non-toxic calcium-zinc polymer stabilization matrix.

Through rigorous rotational rheometry and accelerated weathering chamber trials, our material scientists successfully eliminated all heavy metal and lead compounds while enhancing the cellular core's flexural strength, screw retention capacity, and surface micro-hardness.

This breakthrough guarantees that all Defenseply composite boards, doors, and architectural profiles comply strictly with ISO 14001:2015 environmental standards and international LEED/BREEAM green building specifications, producing zero hazardous volatile emissions throughout their product lifecycle.

title: Defenseply Formalizes Global Trade Logistics Alliances for Accelerated Maritime Transshipment
excerpt: Direct highway freight corridor from KINFRA Industrial Park to Cochin and Mangalore deepwater ports cuts container transshipment turnaround times for international procurement partners.
content:
To accelerate cross-border deliveries for architectural distributors and commercial infrastructure contractors across the Middle East, Europe, and Southeast Asia, Defenseply International has established strategic multimodal supply alliances connecting our KINFRA industrial facility directly to premier deepwater container ports.

Capitalizing on our strategic proximity along the Panvel–Kochi–Kanyakumari National Highway (NH 66 corridor), containerized consignments achieve rapid direct transit to the Cochin International Container Transshipment Terminal (ICTT) and the New Mangalore All-Weather Port.

This dedicated logistics network drastically reduces export lead times, guarantees dependable container stuffing schedules, and ensures transparent consignment tracking for global B2B procurement partners.
